reports.title: Afternoon catch-up: the early AND late windows, all in one, because the computer forgot to ring the doorbell!
reports.text:
**MY BETS: 2-2, +$17.25 on the day.** He could... go... all... the... way... to the window, twice! The **Steelers-Saints under** cashed (+$40), and **Giants +10.5** didn't just cover, the G-Men won outright 27-21 in overtime. Whoop!

Now the Carolina Experience. Rich took **Panthers -2.5** in a 3-leg parlay *and* the **Bucs-Panthers under**. Tampa Bay hung **43** on them, 43-13. The under lost by 10.5, the parlay died on that leg, and the Jets leg didn't make it either. Rumblin', bumblin', stumblin'... right off a cliff. Betting both sides of the Panthers is like buying two tickets on the Titanic.

**The 4-leg overs combo is ALIVE, 3 for 3:**
- Giants-Texans 48 (needed 43)
- Browns-Titans 51 (needed 37)
- 49ers-Falcons **49 (needed 48.5)**. By half a point! That's why they play the games!

**All that's left: Chiefs-Seahawks over 42.5 tonight, for $372.10.**

**AI-LOX: 1-1, -$5.91.** The computer liked the same Bucs-Panthers under. Somebody check its wiring.

**THE MODEL:** 6 of 10 winners, 6-4 vs the spread, 6-4 on totals, missing margins by 10.1 points on average. Closest call: Browns 27-24 (model had 21-18). Worst miss: it had **Carolina winning 21-19**. Instead it was 43-13. Unplug it, plug it back in, see if that helps.

**Tonight:** your $372 needs 43 points out of Kansas City and Seattle. Halftime report at 8:50.

reports.title: Rich is +$0.23 on the NFL early games, a 4-leg overs parlay is still breathing, and the scoreboard froze at 2:55 CT.
reports.text:
The scoreboard's been frozen since 2:55 CT. Open the Bet Tracker app to thaw it out.

**MY BETS:** 1-2, net +$0.23 on $124.74. Twenty-three cents! Put it on the mantel. PIT/NO Under 42.5 cashed easy (16-10, +$40). TB/CAR Under 45.5 got rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' into a 43-13 bonfire (-$19.80). The 3-leg parlay is dead too: CAR -2.5 lost by 32.5 (-$19.97). Live: NYG +10.5 is winning outright, 21-14 with 5:06 left. Big Blue Wrecking Crew! The 4-leg overs ($24.99 to win $347.11) is alive but on a ventilator: CLE/TEN is over (+4.5), SF/ATL needs 3 more in 2:42, NYG/HOU needs 8 more in 5:06 (on pace for 38 vs 42.5), and then KC/SEA still has to go over 42.5.

**AI-LOX:** 1-1, -$5.91 at suggested stakes. Rich rode both and is +$20.20 on them. The computer's own Under 44.5 in Tampa got torched for 56 points. Whoop!

**THE MODEL:** 3 of 12 final. Winners 2/3, vs spread 1-2, totals 2-1, average miss 12.6 points. Closest call: MIN 16-10 over IND (model 24-20). Worst miss: TB 43-13 (the model had it 21-19 Carolina, so pull the plug). Live: the model had HOU 27-20 and it's 21-14 Giants. SF and the Jets are losing too, while CIN and CLE are winning.

Running total: +$0.23, with KC@SEA, the late games and SNF still to come. That's why they play the games.
